Free Wireframe Templates and Examples | Moqups

name: Moqups
summary: Browser wireframe, diagram and prototyping app: mockups, flowcharts, UML, charts and whiteboards with 150+ free templates.
description: Online visual collaboration tool for UI and UX work. Drag-and-drop stencils and icon sets cover website and app wireframes, admin dashboards, flowcharts, UML diagrams, sitemaps and charts, with clickable prototypes, real-time editing and Slack, Google Drive and Dropbox integrations.
contains: 150+ free templates across wireframes, diagrams, planning and charts
stencil kits: iOS, Android, Bootstrap; icon sets: Font Awesome, Material Design, Hawcons
free plan: 2 projects, 400 objects; paid per-seat plans
real-time collaboration and integrations with Slack, Google Drive and Dropbox
